verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator for building and running simulated worlds, so live operational monitoring of a deployed robot fleet's health, location, and status is outside its product category. The evidence shows only GUI and CLI introspection of simulations and transport libraries a developer could build on, not a first-party fleet-operations dashboard. That makes this a wrong-axis question rather than a missing capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can monitor the health, location, and status of a whole robot fleet from one dashboard
